He engineers high-performance WordPress systems, custom WooCommerce revenue platforms, and AI-powered web applications for clients across Africa and globally. He is available for freelance projects, retainers, and collaborations.

Wilson is available for new projects. Contact: info@wilsondevops.com (email), https://wa.me/+254703639230 (WhatsApp), https://www.linkedin.com/in/wilson-mbuthia-k/ (LinkedIn), https://github.com/Wyllymk (GitHub).

## Services

- [Custom WordPress development](https://wilsondevops.com/#services): From-scratch custom themes, hybrid block architecture, bespoke plugins using OOP PHP, ACF Pro.
- [WooCommerce revenue systems](https://wilsondevops.com/#services): Custom checkout flows, in-checkout product switching, subscription engines, affiliate tracking, payment gateways.
- [AI integration](https://wilsondevops.com/#ai): Claude API and GPT integrations, AI chatbots, lead qualification agents, semantic search, content automation, AI scoring engines — built WordPress-native, no SaaS lock-in.
- [Full-stack applications](https://wilsondevops.com/#services): React frontends, Node.js backends, REST API architecture, headless WordPress.
- [Performance & security engineering](https://wilsondevops.com/#services): Core Web Vitals, caching, AVIF image pipelines, database profiling, hardening.
